messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-8462 — inference-api-prod: elevated 5xx and DB/Cache connection saturation. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-8462

pagerduty: Alert details:
- Service: inference-api-prod
- Symptom: 502/504 spike, client timeouts, queueing at DB layer
- Trigger: pgbouncer_waiting > 1000 for > 2m, redis-rejected-conns metric high
- Severity: P1

Mike B: acked and on it. I'll start triage. :wave:

Mike B: quick snapshot from the dashboards (19:02:14):
- 5xx rate: 34% (baseline ~0.5%)
- pgbouncer_total_max: 5000, active: 4892, waiting: 1184
- pg-conn-errors: auth/timeout spikes
- redis-cluster cache-prod-1: maxclients reached on 2/3 nodes, clients rejected ~12k/min
- API 99p latency 3.2s -> 18s

Sam W: copying the runbook steps. any immediate customer-facing mitigation we can flip?

Mike B: doing two things now:
1) throttle background/batch jobs hitting DB (job-dispatcher -> paused)
2) increase pgbouncer pool and reload config to drop idle sessions

Laura C: good. also prepare to enable soft-model-fallback to smaller model variant to reduce token pressure if we need to shed load. prepping route toggle.

Mike B: running commands now:
```bash
# scale pgbouncer deployment temporarily
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/pgbouncer --replicas=6
# reload pgbouncer config so clients drop queued connections less aggressively
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/pgbouncer -- pgbouncer -R -d /etc/pgbouncer/pgbouncer.ini
```

Mike B: pgbouncer scale started, pods creating (19:06).

Anya R: I'll take redis side. trying to reduce idle clients and flush stale subscriber conns. running redis-cli to list client types.

Anya R: redis-client list shows many "idle" clients from legacy workers. evicting ~12k stale clients across nodes.

Anya R: commands run:
```bash
redis-cli -h cache-prod-1 CLIENT KILL TYPE normal IDLETIME 600
redis-cli -h cache-prod-2 CLIENT KILL TYPE normal IDLETIME 600
```
response: killed ~6k, ~5.2k, node3 ~0.8k

Mike B: Postgres side: running quick query to see active sessions:
```sql
SELECT state, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY state;
-- output snippet
 active | 4820
 idle  | 2600
 idle_in_transaction | 40
```
We have >4800 active, which maps to pgbouncer active. Lots of short-lived spike connections.

Sam W: I'm cutting non-essential traffic: turning off some heavy analytics endpoints, and toggling model-routing to use cached embeddings where possible.

pagerduty: Escalation policy note: if owners do not make progress in 10m escalate to Eng Lead.

Mike B: after pgbouncer pods came up and redis evictions: metrics at 19:15:
- 5xx rate down 34% -> 9%
- pgbouncer_waiting 1184 -> 72
- redis rejected connections -> near 0
- API 99p latency 18s -> 3.4s

Laura C: big improvement. good work. need to stabilize for 30m then do root-cause. Customer impact: some high-throughput customers experienced timeouts between 19:00-19:12 UTC; CS informed and we created INC-8123 to track outreach.

Mike B: I'm going to hold the temporary scaling for 20m and then start draining one extra pgbouncer pod to rebalance. will leave runbook notes in the incident doc.

Anya R: confirming cache nodes healthy. Redis maxclients currently 16k on each, usage ~45% now. no evictions in last 5m.

Sam W: taking incident to post-mortem lead. I'll handle handoff to daytime oncall in 25m. Need follow-ups:
- identify source of surge (background job vs client behavior)
- harden client library retry to avoid connection storms
- add alert to warn on sustained idle-client counts

Mike B: handoff to Sam W at 19:25 UTC. leaving monitoring and temporary scale flags in place.

Sam W: acked and on deck for the rest of the window. I will open a follow-up ticket for DB team to investigate long-lived client churn.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PD-8462 acknowledged and mitigated enough to reduce customer impact. Time to mitigation: ~13m. Postmortem required.

Laura C: thanks team. I'll coordinate customer comms and schedule the postmortem. closing the chat window once Sam confirms stable for 30m. :thumbsup:

Sam W: status check 19:53 — metrics stable, no regressions. marking incident owner: Sam W, RCA assigned to Mike B and Anya R.

Sam W: closing the thread for now, will reopen if anything flares.
